newsitem.title: USA: Closing arguments set in Time Warner case.
newsitem.headline: Closing arguments set in Time Warner case.

text.p: A federal judge set closing arguments for Wednesday in Time Warner Inc's suit against New York City aimed at stopping it from airing Rupert Murdoch's Fox News Network or Bloomberg Television News on city-run cable channels.
Fox News is a recently formed unit of News Corp.
The hearing is scheduled to begin at 0930 EST/ 1430 GMT before U.S. District Judge Denise Cote in Manhattan federal court.
Cote said during a hearing Tuesday that she does not expect to rule on Wednesday, but does plan to issue a decision quickly.
